claims.text: The CoVoST dataset was created from 11 languages into English, involving over 11,000 speakers and more than 60 accents.
The dataset creation methodology includes quality checks to ensure the translations meet specific criteria.
CoVoST is released under a CC0 license, making it free to use for the community.
